purpose: Contract-neutral database source change: the freshly re-sealed contract is byte-identical, so current-contract.json cannot change. Checked by scripts/verify-database-contract-coupling.mjs only when this file changes in the same commit.
change: Stage 2 v5.3: the A34 closure first revokes ACL entries granted TO the separate physical superuser role named postgres (residue of releases run before ACL grantees were mapped) on objects the release owner owns, before its unchanged fail-closed check.
